scheduleSteps.label: Vault opens: final glyphs + full seed

milestoneRule._note: INSTANT crossing. A milestone triggers on the first poll where market cap >= the threshold on ANY one reliable source (minSources: 1). Where a source exposes a recent high (GeckoTerminal OHLCV high since the last poll) that high is used, so a brief spike between polls still counts. Once triggered it NEVER un-triggers. No sustained-duration requirement. The bot polls every 5 minutes, so a reveal lands within a few minutes of the crossing.
